info.name: INYATRI - Complete Master API Collection (All Modules)
info.description: Complete single Postman collection containing ALL APIs for the entire INYATRI platform. Covers both User and Admin portals across all modules: Authentication, Self-Drive Rentals, Monthly Car Subscriptions, Cab Booking Engine (One-Way with multi-stops, Round-Trip, Local Hourly Packages, and Airport point-to-point), Master Data (Brands, Types, Features, States, Cities), Inventory Cars Management, Coupons Management, PayU Payment Gateway, and Webhook Simulators.

item.name: 1. User APIs
item.description: All client-facing endpoints for mobile and web apps: Authentication, Self-Drive Rentals, Monthly Subscriptions, Cab Booking Flow (One-Way, Round-Trip, Local, Airport), Booking History, and Payment Operations.
